fusions.location: Whoever the game hands it to: most townsfolk, animals and Minish can offer one
fusions.result: A tree in eastern North Hyrule Field opens, with a Fairy Fountain inside

fusions.location: Whoever the game hands it to: most townsfolk, animals and Minish can offer one
fusions.result: The north-east fountain in Hyrule Castle Garden drains, leading to a Piece of Heart

fusions.location: On the bridge into town, when Link first arrives after Deepwood Shrine
fusions.result: A thorn-blocked tree near Link's House opens, with a Piece of Heart inside
fusions.note: The tutorial fusion: he gives Link the Kinstone Bag and the piece to fuse. Afterwards he's in Mama's Cafe as a random fuser.

fusions.location: His house in the north-east of town
fusions.result: A puddle in the Lon Lon Ranch pasture dries up, revealing stairs to a chest with the Big Wallet
fusions.note: The red piece he needs is in a chest down the steps outside his house.

fusions.location: The Stranger's House, a yellow-roofed house in town
fusions.result: A glowing portal appears west of Link's House, leading to part of the Home of the Wind Tribe
fusions.missable: The fusion can't be missed, but follow up what it opens before reaching the Cloud Tops, or a side quest it leads to is lost.
fusions.note: Gregal is in the house it leads to; helping him gives 100 Mysterious Shells and, later, the Light Arrows.

fusions.location: Running his round through town; stand in his way to stop him
fusions.result: Marcy starts selling the Swordsman Newsletter at the Post Office

fusions.location: Happy Hearth Inn, upstairs; on the Library roof after the Royal Crypt, back at the inn after the Palace of Winds
fusions.result: A shoal rises in the Trilby Highlands lake, leading to a cave with a red Kinstone Piece and a Fairy Fountain
fusions.requires: The cave needs the Flippers and the Mole Mitts.

fusions.location: Happy Hearth Inn, top floor, with Din and Nayru
fusions.result: Gorman comes to town looking for a tenant for his Vacant House
fusions.note: Whoever of the three Oracles rents the house moves in. GameFAQs says any Oracle can do this fusion; Zelda Wiki, Thonky and Zelda Dungeon say Farore.

fusions.location: Next to the Post Office
fusions.result: Mutoh is inspired to build a second Vacant House in town for Gorman to rent
fusions.requires: Farore's first fusion, followed through to a tenant moving in. Bremor shows up once Link has the Flippers.
fusions.note: Bremor leaves town after fusing.

fusions.location: Behind the bar in Mama's Cafe
fusions.result: A shoal rises in Lake Hylia, leading to a cave with 50 Rupees
fusions.requires: The cave needs the Mole Mitts.

fusions.location: In a tiny house in a bookshelf of the Royal Hyrule Library
fusions.result: A Golden Octorok appears in the Wind Ruins
fusions.note: The Library closes late in the story. Librari then lives in Lake Hylia, once the last Minish Village fusion opens the way there.

fusions.location: Happy Hearth Inn, or the Vacant House if she rented it
fusions.result: A Joy Butterfly appears in the Wind Ruins; catching it lets Link shoot arrows faster

fusions.location: Happy Hearth Inn, or the Vacant House if she rented it
fusions.result: A Joy Butterfly appears in the Royal Valley; catching it lets Link swim faster

fusions.location: Happy Hearth Inn, or the Vacant House if she rented it
fusions.result: A Joy Butterfly appears in Castor Wilds; catching it lets Link dig faster with the Mole Mitts

fusions.location: Funday School
fusions.result: A chest appears among the rocks in central Trilby Highlands with a red Kinstone Piece
fusions.note: She only sometimes wants to fuse: leave and come back until she does. Often the last one people find.

fusions.location: Link's House
fusions.result: A big chest appears in the Eastern Hills, south of the farm, with an Empty Bottle

fusions.location: Link's House
fusions.result: A chest appears in north-east Trilby Highlands with a red Kinstone Piece

fusions.location: On the ledge east of Link's House
fusions.result: The north-west of the four trees in North Hyrule Field opens: a switch and a red Kinstone Piece
fusions.requires: He appears after Link first fails to cross Castor Wilds.
fusions.note: One of the four Tingle trees. Pressing all four switches lowers a ladder to the Magical Boomerang.

fusions.location: A tiny house in a stump in the south-west of the field; dash into the lone tree first
fusions.result: Syrup is inspired to brew Red Potion, and sells it at her hut

fusions.location: On the ledge east of Link's House
fusions.result: A Golden Tektite appears on Mt. Crenel, worth 200 Rupees
fusions.requires: Fuse with all four Tingle brothers first.

fusions.location: The Mole Mitts cave by the steps near Syrup's hut; dig to the far wall
fusions.result: The Goron at Lon Lon Ranch digs open the Goron Cave, or another Goron joins him if it's already open
fusions.requires: The Mole Mitts.
fusions.note: One of the six Goron Cave fusions (Eenie and five walls). The piece depends on how many are done, not on the wall.

fusions.location: The Minish in the west house of Minish Village, or Zill in Hyrule Town (or the Town Minish in the new house)
fusions.result: A lily pad appears in the small north-west swamp of Castor Wilds, with a blue Kinstone Piece beyond
fusions.note: The first of three lily pads; any of these partners gives the next one. Zill moves around town as the story goes on.

fusions.location: The Minish in the west house of Minish Village, or Zill in Hyrule Town (or the Town Minish in the new house)
fusions.result: A lily pad appears in the big north-west swamp of Castor Wilds, leading to a red Kinstone Piece and an underwater cave with a Piece of Heart
fusions.requires: The underwater cave needs the Flippers.
fusions.note: The second lily pad. Zelda Wiki doesn't list the Piece of Heart under this fusion; GameFAQs and Zelda Dungeon's Heart Piece list do.

fusions.location: The Minish in the west house of Minish Village, or Zill in Hyrule Town (or the Town Minish in the new house)
fusions.result: A lily pad appears in the south-west swamp of Castor Wilds, with a red Kinstone Piece beyond
fusions.note: The third lily pad; ride the second one's leaf to reach it.

fusions.location: Inside the tree the Castor Wilds Scrub's fusion opens
fusions.result: A Golden Octorok appears in Western Wood
fusions.requires: The Castor Wilds Business Scrub's fusion.

fusions.location: Inside the tree the Castor Wilds Scrub's fusion opens
fusions.result: A crack opens in north-west Castor Wilds with a chest holding a red Kinstone Piece
fusions.requires: The Castor Wilds Business Scrub's fusion.

fusions.location: His house just west of Minish Village, where Link got the bombs
fusions.result: A chest appears below the Fortress of Winds in the Wind Ruins with the Big Bomb Bag
fusions.requires: The Water Element.

fusions.location: The elder's house in Minish Village
fusions.result: Belari is inspired to make Remote Bombs; Link can swap between them and normal Bombs at his house
fusions.requires: The Water Element.

fusions.location: The pink-roofed house across the water in north-east Minish Village; swim there
fusions.result: A shoal rises at Veil Falls, leading to a cave with a Piece of Heart and 50 Mysterious Shells
fusions.requires: The Flippers, and the Wind Element.
fusions.note: GameFAQs says this Minish also has a random fusion, before these two.

fusions.partner: Forest Picori (Minish Village lake house, second)
fusions.location: The pink-roofed house across the water in north-east Minish Village
fusions.result: A crack opens by the Lake Hylia Wind Crest, leading to Librari's island home, where he gives a Heart Container
fusions.requires: The Flippers, and the Wind Element.

fusions.location: Outside the Goron Cave; once it's open, the leftmost Goron inside
fusions.result: The Goron Merchant opens a stall in the Hyrule Town square, selling Kinstone Pieces

fusions.location: In a cave in the north-west of the pasture, through a Minish Portal
fusions.result: The north-east of the four trees in North Hyrule Field opens: a switch and a red Kinstone Piece
fusions.requires: He appears after Link has spoken to Tingle.
fusions.note: One of the four Tingle trees. Pressing all four switches lowers a ladder to the Magical Boomerang.

fusions.location: The far right of the Goron Cave
fusions.result: Biggoron wakes up at Veil Springs
fusions.requires: All six Goron Cave fusions.
fusions.note: Biggoron swallows Link's shield and gives back the Mirror Shield, but only after the game is beaten and saved.

fusions.location: Eenie and Meenie's farm
fusions.result: The Goron at Lon Lon Ranch digs open the Goron Cave, or another Goron joins him if it's already open
fusions.missable: European version: if you start this fusion, cancel it and leave, Eenie never offers it again.
fusions.note: One of the six Goron Cave fusions with the five Mysterious Walls, done in any order. When all six Gorons are there they break the last wall, behind which is an Empty Bottle.

fusions.location: Eenie and Meenie's farm
fusions.result: A chest appears on a ledge halfway up the Crenel Wall with a blue Kinstone Piece

fusions.location: The Mole Mitts cave in Eenie and Meenie's garden; the far corner
fusions.result: The Goron at Lon Lon Ranch digs open the Goron Cave, or another Goron joins him if it's already open
fusions.requires: The Mole Mitts.
fusions.note: One of the six Goron Cave fusions (Eenie and five walls). The piece depends on how many are done, not on the wall.

fusions.location: The mushroom house in the south-west corner of the Eastern Hills
fusions.result: A beanstalk grows in the Eastern Hills, with a Piece of Heart and chests of 200 Rupees and 200 Mysterious Shells

fusions.location: Stockwell's dog, at his house; Link has to be Minish-sized
fusions.result: A chest appears on the Minish path into Mayor Hagen's cabin with a blue Kinstone Piece

fusions.location: By the water south of Stockwell's House
fusions.result: The south-east of the four trees in North Hyrule Field opens: a switch and 200 Mysterious Shells
fusions.note: One of the four Tingle trees. Pressing all four switches lowers a ladder to the Magical Boomerang.

fusions.location: The Minish house next to the Lake Hylia Wind Crest
fusions.result: A tree in Western Wood, on the way to Castor Wilds, opens with a Piece of Heart inside

fusions.location: By the water south of Stockwell's House
fusions.result: A chest appears on the Minish path into Melari's Mine with 200 Mysterious Shells
fusions.requires: His first fusion. GameFAQs adds the Magical Boomerang.

fusions.location: A Minish crack on a ledge on the east side of the lake: shrink at the south-east stump, swim north and climb the vine
fusions.result: A beanstalk grows in northern Lake Hylia, with a Piece of Heart and chests of 200 Rupees and 200 Mysterious Shells
fusions.requires: Reaching the beanstalk takes the Roc's Cape.

fusions.location: The Mole Mitts cave on the island in northern Lake Hylia
fusions.result: The Goron at Lon Lon Ranch digs open the Goron Cave, or another Goron joins him if it's already open
fusions.requires: The Mole Mitts and the Roc's Cape.
fusions.note: One of the six Goron Cave fusions (Eenie and five walls). The piece depends on how many are done, not on the wall.

fusions.location: His dojo in a tree on the south-west shore; needs the Flippers
fusions.result: A gap opens in a waterfall in North Hyrule Field, leading to Greatblade's dojo

fusions.location: Melari's Mine, in the south-east dining hall; there once Link has the White Sword
fusions.result: A Golden Tektite appears on Mt. Crenel
fusions.note: Thonky counts this as random; Zelda Wiki, GameFAQs and the game's own data give it to this Minish.

fusions.location: A Minish crack at the foot of Mt. Crenel, behind cobwebs (Gust Jar)
fusions.result: A chest appears at the foot of Mt. Crenel with 200 Rupees

fusions.location: Melari's Mine, by the west exit
fusions.result: A chest appears in south-west Minish Woods, across the bridge from the Wind Crest, with a blue Kinstone Piece

fusions.location: Melari's Mine; there after Vaati takes the King's place
fusions.result: A bean at the top of Mt. Crenel grows into a beanstalk with 160 Rupees and a Piece of Heart

fusions.location: Melari's Mine, by the door to the bedroom
fusions.result: A chest appears on the rainy Minish path on Mt. Crenel with a blue Kinstone Piece

fusions.location: Melari's Mine, the north-west Minish with the pickaxe
fusions.result: A chest appears on the Minish path to the hot spring on Mt. Crenel with a blue Kinstone Piece

fusions.location: The Mole Mitts cave next to the Crenel Hermit's, at the top of the Crenel Wall
fusions.result: The Goron at Lon Lon Ranch digs open the Goron Cave, or another Goron joins him if it's already open
fusions.requires: The Mole Mitts.
fusions.note: One of the six Goron Cave fusions (Eenie and five walls). The piece depends on how many are done, not on the wall.

fusions.location: His cave dojo high on the east side of Mt. Crenel; it takes the split to get in
fusions.result: A gap opens in a waterfall in north-east Castor Wilds, leading to Scarblade's dojo

fusions.location: Inside a tree in Trilby Highlands
fusions.result: A fallen tree in Western Wood rises, opening the way to Percy's House
fusions.note: A side quest at his house later gives 100 Mysterious Shells.

fusions.location: The Mole Mitts cave north of the way up to Mt. Crenel, beside the ladder
fusions.result: The Goron at Lon Lon Ranch digs open the Goron Cave, or another Goron joins him if it's already open
fusions.requires: The Mole Mitts.
fusions.note: One of the six Goron Cave fusions (Eenie and five walls). The piece depends on how many are done, not on the wall.

fusions.location: North-west Trilby Highlands, through the Mole Mitts cave
fusions.result: The south-west of the four trees in North Hyrule Field opens: a switch and a red Kinstone Piece
fusions.requires: The Mole Mitts, to reach him.
fusions.note: One of the four Tingle trees. Pressing all four switches lowers a ladder to the Magical Boomerang.

fusions.location: The mushroom house next to Knuckle, through a Minish Portal
fusions.result: A pool in Trilby Highlands drains, revealing a cave with 75 Rupees

fusions.location: The mushroom house in south-west Western Wood
fusions.result: A beanstalk grows in Western Wood with 320 Rupees and a chest holding a red Kinstone Piece

fusions.location: His cave on the north edge of Castor Wilds; beat him first
fusions.result: A tree in Minish Woods, north of Deepwood Shrine, opens: another Business Scrub inside sells Kinstone Pieces
fusions.note: That Scrub then has two fusions of his own.

fusions.location: The three statues in south-west Castor Wilds
fusions.result: The boulder nearby cracks; with all three statues fused it shatters, opening the way to the Wind Ruins
fusions.note: The three Gold pieces are in caves around Castor Wilds.

fusions.location: The three statues in south-west Castor Wilds
fusions.result: The boulder nearby cracks; with all three statues fused it shatters, opening the way to the Wind Ruins
fusions.note: The three Gold pieces are in caves around Castor Wilds.

fusions.location: The three statues in south-west Castor Wilds
fusions.result: The boulder nearby cracks; with all three statues fused it shatters, opening the way to the Wind Ruins
fusions.note: The three Gold pieces are in caves around Castor Wilds.

fusions.location: A Minish crack near the first tree stump
fusions.result: A bean in the Wind Ruins grows into a beanstalk with the Large Quiver at the top

fusions.location: A Minish house in a stump on the east side; dash into a tree first
fusions.result: A chest appears in the south of the Wind Ruins, among four face pillars, with 200 Mysterious Shells

fusions.location: A Minish crack behind a hedge in the north-east corner
fusions.result: A fallen tree in eastern Western Wood rises; dig behind it with the Mole Mitts for 400 Rupees

fusions.location: His dojo down a ladder under the bushes in the south-east
fusions.result: A gap opens in a waterfall at Veil Falls, leading to Splitblade's dojo

fusions.location: The ghost by the graveyard in the Royal Valley; talk to him first
fusions.result: Borlov's Chest Mini-Game Shop in town adds a harder level
fusions.note: Zelda Wiki says this ghost is Spekter and his brother in town Spookter; Zelda Dungeon's walkthrough swaps the names.

fusions.location: The ghost by the graveyard in the Royal Valley
fusions.result: His brother Spookter leaves Anju's Henhouse in Hyrule Town, so Link can get in as a Minish

fusions.location: His house outside the graveyard gates
fusions.result: A grave in the north-east of the graveyard opens: Gina is inside, with a chest of 100 Mysterious Shells
fusions.note: Gina then has two fusions of her own.

fusions.location: His house outside the graveyard gates
fusions.result: A crack opens in the middle of the Wind Ruins, with a chest holding a red Kinstone Piece

fusions.location: Inside her grave, the one Dampé's first fusion opens
fusions.result: A gap opens in the waterfall in western Hyrule Town, with a chest of 200 Mysterious Shells
fusions.requires: Dampé's first fusion.

fusions.location: Inside her grave
fusions.result: A fallen tree in northern Western Wood rises, with a chest of 100 Mysterious Shells behind it
fusions.requires: Dampé's first fusion.

fusions.location: The stone slab at the end of the bridge at Veil Falls
fusions.result: The slab opens, and the caves behind it lead up Veil Falls to Veil Springs and the way to the Cloud Tops
fusions.note: Its Gold piece comes from Gustaf in the Royal Crypt.

fusions.location: The Home of the Wind Tribe, third floor
fusions.result: A Golden Rope appears in northern Castor Wilds
fusions.requires: Reach the Home of the Wind Tribe through the Cloud Tops.

fusions.location: The Home of the Wind Tribe, third floor
fusions.result: A fallen tree in northern Western Wood rises; dig behind it with the Mole Mitts for 300 Rupees
fusions.requires: Reach the Home of the Wind Tribe through the Cloud Tops.

fusions.location: The Home of the Wind Tribe, the bedroom floor
fusions.result: A chest appears among the rocks in north-east Veil Falls with a blue Kinstone Piece

fusions.location: Near the hole down to Veil Falls, or in the Home of the Wind Tribe (sources differ)

fusions.location: Near the Cloud Tops entrance, or the bottom floor of the Home of the Wind Tribe (sources differ)
